notes.title: Method and period
notes.amounts: Amounts are TRY, VAT inclusive; days and months follow the Europe/Istanbul calendar.
notes.scope_branches: Only the records of your branches are included; head-office (no branch) records are not.
notes.occupancy: Occupancy = time on rent / available time. Available time is the service life minus usage blocks (maintenance, damage, cleaning, out of service); the vehicle profitability calculation is used.
notes.multi_group: {{count}} vehicles are in several rental groups and count in each; group rows may add up to more than the total.
notes.income_expense: Income: rent and charge accruals of customer accounts (by entry date, net of reversals). Expense: recorded expenses (by expense date, supplier invoices included, voided ones excluded).
notes.kept_apart: Tolls passed through to the customer are not income and vehicle procurement is not an expense; both are shown apart.
notes.channels: Revenue and commission are the sold price of confirmed reservations (VAT inclusive). Cancellation rate = cancelled / all reservations; pending, expired and no-show are counted apart.
notes.source: The channel comes from the reservation's sales channel field; new channels from the channel manager appear here with their code.
notes.aging: Open amounts are spread by days past their due date; collections and payments settle the oldest debt first (FIFO). Deposits are excluded.
notes.branches: Branches are compared by their vehicles' home branch; the figures are the branch totals of the vehicle profitability report.
notes.unallocated: Overhead of branches without a vehicle in service (not allocated): {{amount}}
